summary: M27 Cricketing Season global filter tested end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_m27_season_filter.py (14 tests, 14/14 pass) covering: (a) 7 major list endpoints accept ?fiscal_cycle=2026-27 with 200 (tournaments, tournament-budgets, reimbursement-claims, tournament-invoices, budgets, claims, vendor-bills); (b) 4 non-fiscal endpoints (bodies, personas, shared/roles, shared/constants) IGNORE fiscal_cycle (never return 422); (c) cross-season isolation — POST /tournaments with fiscal_cycle=2026-27 appears in 2026-27 list and is absent from 2023-24 list; (d) Create→GET verification of fiscal_cycle persistence; (e) omitting fiscal_cycle keeps 200. FULL M26 regression: 21/21 pass (test_m26_phase_e + test_m26_phase_f). Frontend smoke (Playwright, persona-chip-secretary → Sign in): 15/15 checks pass — default value=2026-27 on cleared localStorage; 7 rolling options ['2023-24'..'2029-30']; localStorage.mpca_season + window.__mpca_season populated; axios interceptor auto-injects ?fiscal_cycle=2026-27 on GET /api/tournaments AND /api/tournaments-stats/summary (verified via page.on('request')); Tournaments stat-tile subtitle renders 'Cycle 2026-27 · state-wide'; dropdown change opens portalled [data-testid=season-confirm-modal] with 'from 2026-27 to 2025-26' text; cancel dismisses without persisting; apply persists to localStorage + dropdown reflects new value after reload; season-switcher visible on /dashboard, /members, /schemes, /reimbursement-claims, /ledger; hidden on /login (unauthenticated).
critical_code_review_comments: SeasonSwitcher.confirm() unconditionally calls window.location.reload() after a 100ms delay. This is a legitimate 'kitchen-sink' approach and matches the spec, but it means every season change loses any in-flight XHR responses (retry logic in api.js will surface as broken toasts). Consider using the mpca:season-changed CustomEvent + React Query invalidation instead of a hard reload for a smoother UX.

SeasonContext.buildSeasonList always centres on the *currently selected* season (start = parseInt(currentPin.split('-')[0])). After a user picks 2029-30 the dropdown will now show 2026-27 → 2032-33 — the '3 past / 3 future' window drifts. If the intent per spec was 'always centre on today's real season', pass currentCricketSeason() rather than the selected season.

api.js interceptor injects fiscal_cycle only for GET requests. POST/PATCH/DELETE writes rely on each form component reading window.__mpca_season and setting it in the payload manually — this is enforced in 6 files per the spec but is not lint-checked. A ticket/regression to grep for every 'fiscal_cycle:' literal in /components /pages and assert === window.__mpca_season would prevent drift.

DEFAULT_SEASON is hard-coded to '2026-27' in SeasonContext. When the calendar rolls to Aug 2027, this default will feel stale for a new user with an empty localStorage. Consider computing DEFAULT_SEASON = currentCricketSeason() with '2026-27' only as an *initial deploy pin*, then remove after Aug 2027.

Fiscal cycle isolation test showed POST /tournaments requires 'scope' ∈ {Inter_Divisional, Inter_District, Championship, Invitational} — not 'state'. Not a bug for M27, but the API's Pydantic literal is coupled to old Phase-2 taxonomy; documenting acceptable values in the OpenAPI schema description would prevent frontend/test drift.

Note for frontend testers: persona login on /login is a two-step flow — click [data-testid=persona-chip-<role>] then click the 'Sign in to the Registrar' button (or use page.get_by_role('button', name='Sign in to the Registrar')). Also, the axios interceptor only auto-injects fiscal_cycle on GET — POST payload defaults rely on 6 explicit form files reading window.__mpca_season; if a new create form is added, it must be updated to include fiscal_cycle. Season options window drifts with current selection (see code review item #2).
